Alex Chen: hey team — first day here in Eng Tools. running into a sync mess: my primary is alex@redwood.dev but I also have an alias alex@redwood.com that I was told would be provisioned. Google Drive shows 'access denied' for company folders and 1Password app shows my seat as 'pending'. Okta login loops me back to the company selector. Anyone know who to ping or quick workarounds? :wave:
Okta Bot: [automated] Provisioning event received for login alex@redwood.com — created duplicate account (temp) pending merge. Ticket IT-3421 created.
Priya Patel: @Alex Chen welcome! I can take a look. Quick Q: can you confirm the exact email that you used to sign up to 1Password and whether you accepted the invite link?
Alex Chen: thanks @Priya — I accepted the 1Password invite (used alex@redwood.dev). The invite email for alex@redwood.com bounced earlier so I thought alias wasn't required. I'm signed into Chrome as alex@personal@gmail.com too which might be messing SSO.
Morgan Lee: try two quick things: 1) open an incognito window and go to the SSO sign-in (https://redwood.okta.com). 2) if that doesn't work, sign out of all Google accounts then sign in with your @redwood.dev account and click the 'Sign in with Okta' button. Sometimes the browser session picks the wrong profile.
Alex Chen: doing incognito now... still hitting the Okta loop, it flashes the org chooser and comes back.
Priya Patel: thanks — @Morgan + @Sam I'll merge the duplicates. Alex, I'll add the alias to your primary Okta record and force a re-provision to Google Workspace. After I do that, please fully sign out of Chrome (all accounts) or use Incognito and try again.
Sam Rivera: FYI on 1Password: I just confirmed the seat assignment is pending on our admin side; I've pushed the assignment manually. Ticket IT-3421 updated: 1Password seat assigned to Alex Chen (engineering).
Okta Bot: [automated] Alias alex@redwood.com added to user okta|U2615801234. Profile sync to Google Workspace queued.
Priya Patel: done — I merged the temp account and re-provisioned the alias. Alex, after you sign out and sign back in with alex@redwood.dev SSO should route correctly. If it still loops, paste the exact URL you see and I'll escalate to Okta support.
Alex Chen: signed out of all accounts, cleared cookies, reopened incognito and signed in with alex@redwood.dev SSO — working now. I can access shared drives and the 1Password app shows me as 'Member'. Huge thanks! :tada:
Morgan Lee: awesome, welcome aboard! If you want a quick intro to Eng Tools stack drop by #eng-tools or ping me for a 15min walkthrough. :sparkles:
